items.title: Eddie Johnson Interview, 1962-11-06
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...They called Paul Bonds. [INTERVIEWEE] He was the feature man in the brass band also, in the barate band. And the dance band.

ctx.x: And did you have a tenor player? No. Tenor player, not the brass band.
No, I see. So, I guess sometimes they wouldn't play in both bands. They had a big sax actually. They called Paul Bonds.
He was the feature man in the brass band also, in the barate band. And the dance band.
